findingDetails.title: The hub ships no feature catalog while its predecessor hub and nine other skills do

results.summary: Criterion 2 holds, phase 005's compiled-serving claim holds, and version authority holds across four files.
Criterion 5 holds per mode but not for a combined three-mode request (R1-P1-001, R2-P1-001).
The hub's SKILL.md names no agent contract, so there is no SKILL.md-to-agent pair to compare.
No agent definition in the three runtime trees names the hub or any of its three modes, so no cross-runtime agent pair exists.
The hub ships no feature-catalog/ (R7-P2-001). The sibling mcp-tooling catalog carries no stale browser-mode claim.

Seven case files and seven index entries, so coverage is complete. MT-H01 passes on stage two alone while the replay marks the same prompt FAIL at stage one; already recorded as R4-P1-001 and not re-raised.

noveltyJustification: One new finding, a P2 capability-inventory gap established by globbing .skilled/skills/*/feature-catalog (ten skills, the hub absent) and reading the sibling mcp-tooling catalog as the parity reference. The one P1 candidate -- MT-H01's stage-two-only pass rule contradicting D7 -- was withdrawn as a duplicate because R4-P1-001 already states it and already cites holdout-browser-inspect.md:46. Ratio is 1 weighted P2 over 29 accumulated weighted findings.
